proposal.hypothesis: Replacing only the parent’s pointwise long_view loss with vectorized same-user BPR, while retaining its engagement auxiliary supervision and representation, will improve within-user ordering and contribute complementary rank signal to the active portfolio.
proposal.implementation_plan: Replace the delegated DeepFM model, training loop, and prediction path with a visible PyTorch implementation matching the parent’s categorical DeepFM structure and four engagement heads. For the long_view head, form train-only user blocks from splits['train'].user_id[train_idx], retain users containing both labels, and on each epoch sample exactly one same-user negative for every positive. Optimize mean softplus(-(z_pos-z_neg)) for the main head while retaining the parent’s pointwise BCE losses for the four engagement auxiliary heads at total weight 0.2. Use k=16, hidden=[128,64], lr=0.001, l2=0.0001, batch=8192, 12 fixed epochs, seed-controlled sampling, and one CPU thread. The prediction block returns only the long_view logit. Include a one-step internal assertion that a synthetic positive-negative logit difference increases under the implemented BPR gradient.
proposal.justification: A same-user pairwise objective directly optimizes candidate differences that affect GAUC and nDCG, whereas global pointwise calibration is partly irrelevant. Retaining the auxiliary heads isolates the tested change to the main ranking objective and preserves the selected parent’s useful engagement representation. Pairwise ordering should also be less correlated with the two pointwise portfolio members.
proposal.mechanism: same-user BPR main head with retained engagement auxiliaries

research_evidence.query: Which ranking objective and sampling implementation reliably improves the official FM?
research_evidence.reason: Cold-start runs repeatedly proposed BPR but implementation quality varied sharply.
research_evidence.summary: Use vectorized same-user BPR, not all-batch quadratic pairing. Build per-user positive blocks and negative pools only for users with both classes; use one sampled same-user negative per positive per epoch; align positive and negative arrays by user block; return safely when no eligible pairs; the FM global bias cancels. The exact loss is L=mean(softplus(-(z_pos-z_neg))). With diff=z_pos-z_neg, use g_pos=(sigmoid(diff)-1)/pair_count and g_neg=-g_pos. At diff=0, g_pos must equal -0.5/pair_count, never +0.5/pair_count; a one-step sanity check must increase z_pos-z_neg. At k=16, lr=0.001, one negative, the five-seed official-validation primary changed from 0.601500738 ± 0.000481897 for pointwise FM to 0.603517127 ± 0.000631158 for BPR. Treat the mechanism and implementation invariants as the prior; rerun it inside the Agent harness rather than assuming the measured delta transfers exactly.

proposal.implementation_plan: In build_target, first obtain the unchanged pointwise_engagement_mtl target from SO.build_target. selection_rationale: Candidate 0 is the only viable candidate and is selected. It tests one attributable change: replacing the main binary target on valid training rows with a bounded 85/15 binary-label/watch-ratio mixture while keeping features, architecture, auxiliary targets, and hyperparameters fixed. The path is demonstrably connected because SO.train consumes target['main']; DV.watch_ratio() is restricted to target construction, invalid duration-zero rows are masked, and no exposure-after-feedback value becomes an inference feature. Its expected gain is credible despite being potentially sub-threshold: continuous supervision may refine within-user ordering, and the conservative mixture limits objective drift. It also provides useful information about whether discarded viewing intensity explains residual ranking errors in the current DeepFM member. Portfolio benefit is not guaranteed because target shaping may preserve correlated errors or misalign with binary long_view, but the implementation and audit contract are reliable, and no exact negative_result matches this parent/operator and target transition. There are no other viable candidates to compare against.
